title: Ball-Product Structure of Cross-Polytope Subcomplexes
statement: Let $B(i,d)$ be the subcomplex of the boundary of the $d$-dimensional cross-polytope generated by facets whose encoding words have at most $i$ switches. Is $B(i,d)$ a combinatorial triangulation of $S^{i}\times B^{d-i-1}$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Topological and Geometric Combinatorics (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/08, pp. 349--423](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/08)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** Klee--Novik proved that the boundary of B(i,d) triangulates the product of spheres, but the stronger ball-product triangulation question remains open in the located literature.

**Sources checked.**

- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/08)
